Frequently asked questions about news websites

How much does a news website cost?

A news website starts from $71.99 on the Economy plan, $161.99 on the Special plan and $377.99 on the Custom plan, with the current discount already applied (regular prices: $79.99, $179.99 and $419.99). The final price is confirmed in a consultation.

How long does it take to build a news website?

The estimated delivery time is 10–15 business days on the Economy plan, 15–30 business days on the Special plan and 30–60 business days on the Custom plan. The exact schedule is confirmed in the contract.

What is the difference between the three plans?

Economy plan: ready-made template with customization; home page, categories and news archive; 1 month of support. Special plan: custom UI design; everything in the base plan + breaking news and special editions; 3 months of support. Custom plan: fully custom design + animation; unlimited, based on the project; 6 months of priority support.

Are domain and hosting included in the price?

No. Domain and hosting costs are charged separately from the plans. Every plan includes responsive design for mobile and tablet and an SSL certificate.

How do I order a news website?

Choose a plan on the Packages page and send the request form. A confirmation email with a pre-contract arrives right away, the team replies after reviewing your request, and the final price is set in a consultation.
